proposed_goal.title: Original install160 timeout evidence and assertion-safe diagnostic retention
proposed_goal.origin: The current full administrator audit emitted failure-0001.json for test_distinct_capture_owner_normal_install_activate_and_restore. install-files.sh exceeded its original approved160-second computer budget; activate/restore did not run. The failure JSON has no full stdin/stdout/stderr or phase/lifetime record and the original fixture was cleaned before investigation. Independent review of the unexecuted diagnostic draft additionally found overwriteable observation outputs and normal-return auxiliary errors able to mask original assertions. These two pre-execution defects were corrected before any diagnostic run; they are not invented runtime REDs or camera faults.
proposed_goal.required_behavior: Preserve original shell, full stdin, argv, original body and all assertions,160/120/120 budgets and original timeout cleanup. Bind current source, candidate and exact original failure. Preserve captured bytes and missing values distinctly; None is unknown, not empty output. Retain bounded post-return/post-exception observations before fixture cleanup without claiming exact deadline state, original inode continuity or native process lifetime. Use the already reviewed no-overwrite publisher, checking every output target and refusing rival leaves at commit. Auxiliary retention/observation errors must not hide the original TimeoutExpired or prevent the original body's returncode and stock-RC assertions. If all original assertions pass but evidence retention fails, the diagnostic still fails. Do not change to alias ownership, cache or omit fresh queries, enlarge deadlines, or infer a hardware cause from static nested captures. Do not execute the additional timing test while the full audit is active.
required_evidence: Keep the current full-audit FAIL at build/peer-route-review-20261011-host-fixed/failure-0001.json SHA89dd9c0ca2903bf356102b3fb377a9011272d848ef30971dc7b3c5813b9acea7. Record the actual unknowns; an independent PASS cannot explain or erase this FAIL.

Retain the pre-execution review findings and corrected diagnostic source. Dynamic controls must verify no-overwrite output behavior, raw None/empty distinctions and original assertion/error priority. Also retain the actual4-case public-main FAIL-binding RED/GREEN: missing or modified original FAIL must reject before execution, exact raw bytes must be archived, and an existing archive must remain unchanged. These substituted filesystem/subprocess-boundary controls do not prove native install160 execution or audit workload completion. Static review and AST parsing alone are not those controls or a release PASS.

Use a fresh execution of the unchanged original node to collect actual stdin/session/context, returned or timeout streams and limited fixture state with exact source/runtime bindings. Further phase, held-handle, native-birth or reader-EOF evidence is required before choosing validation-cost or pipe-ownership root cause; post-exception observations alone do not close it.

Retain the shared completed-audit admission correction and its controls: a launcher-result file merely existing cannot establish natural completion, actual collection/XML completeness or exact recorded Windows lifetime termination. Reuse the existing verified gate before outputs/fixture/original workload. A targeted known-actor observation must bind the original failure and captured PID/birth records, preserve all original deadlines and not claim arbitrary helpers or computer-wide quiescence.

Retain the independent availability defect found before any native diagnostic: the copied observation sampler used ! -e /proc/PID/stat to emit absent, which can also mean unavailable or untraversable proc data. Once consumed as an admission condition this unknown must not become termination proof. Add the minimum own-proc availability/identity anchor and exact-PID path refusal; verify through the existing owned host-shell filesystem/OS seam, not solely substituted returned text or source-string checks. The earlier36 passing pure controls remain historical controls, not availability qualification or actual actor-stop samples. Unknown reads, unavailable anchors, same-live lifetimes, truncated results, failed commands and timeouts must reject before original execution without signals, tree scans or general new frameworks.

Retain the native fixture-control load-before-pin defect and its actual pure-entry RED/GREEN: reject changed shared bytes before definition execution and use the same verified raw bytes at both load boundaries. A second mutable path load must not execute unbound definitions after admission. These controls do not execute native shell semantics, original diagnostics or a camera workload.

After an evidence-backed correction, rerun the original failure and every applicable release goal from the beginning. Preserve all first547 goals and seeds, with this new applicability seed APPLICABLE/NOT_RUN/counts_as_pass=false/evidence_refs=[] until actual qualification. No camera write or installation authority is granted.
